newsitem.title: USA: CP Clare CFO Jacqueline Arthur to resign.
newsitem.headline: CP Clare CFO Jacqueline Arthur to resign.

text.p: C.P. Clare Corp Thursday said Jacqueline Arthur, its vice president and chief financial officer, will resign to spend more time with her family.

"Bob Palladino and Tom Sager will together assume the duties of chief financial officer in addition to their responsibilities as the corporate treasurer and the corporate controller, respectively," said Arthur Buckland, president and chief executive officer of C.P. Clare.
C.P. Clare is a provider of semiconductor and electromagnetic relays, switches, and specialized electronic components.
